title: Expert lithological labels do not improve learning when used to predict marine sediment properties
abstract: arXiv:2610.36410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific drilling has produced large archives of physical, chemical and magnetic measurements linked to descriptions of the rock recovered. These archives are mostly incomplete: instruments sample at different intervals, recovery is partial, and destructive analyses preclude later measurement of the same material. We train an self-supervised embedding model on the LILY ocean drilling database using six routinely logged properties (bulk density, magnetic susceptibility, natural gamma radiation, and red, green and blue reflectance) across 236,963 observations from 296 boreholes, with a masked variational autoencoder that has a heteroscedastic Gaussian decoder and learnable mask tokens. The embeddings separate geologist-assigned lithologies as well as a variant trained with those labels, and increasing the weight on the labels degrades reconstruction while leaving classification unchanged. The labels are recoverable from the measurement

translated_title: 专家岩性标签用于预测海洋沉积物性质时并不能改善学习效果
translated_abstract: 科学钻探已经产生了大量与回收岩石描述相关联的物理、化学和磁性测量数据档案。这些档案大多是不完整的：仪器以不同间隔采样，岩芯回收率是部分的，且破坏性分析使得无法对同一材料进行后续测量。我们在LILY海洋钻探数据库上训练了一个自监督嵌入模型，使用了六种常规测井属性（体积密度、磁化率、自然伽马辐射以及红、绿、蓝反射率），涵盖来自296个钻孔的236,963个观测数据，模型采用带有异方差高斯解码器和可学习掩码标记的掩码变分自编码器。结果显示，这些嵌入对地质学家所指定岩性的区分能力与使用这些标签训练的变体相当；而且增加标签的权重会降低重建质量，同时分类性能保持不变。这些标签可以从测量数据中恢复出来。
tldr: 专家标注的岩性标签本身可从常规物理测量数据中恢复，因此在预测海洋沉积物性质的自监督学习中引入这些标签并不能带来性能提升。
en_tdlr: Expert lithological labels are recoverable from routine physical measurements and thus provide no additional benefit to self-supervised learning when predicting marine sediment properties.
